changelog:
Initial release of UI Controller skill.

- Enables automation and control of local user interface actions on the gateway machine.
- Supports triggering UI-related actions and managing desktop behavior.
- Intended for personal automation on Windows platforms.
- Operates only on the machine where the OpenClaw gateway is running.
- Includes a security notice: use only in trusted environments due to desktop control capabilities.
summary: Controls local Windows desktop actions and UI behavior on the machine running the OpenClaw gateway for personal automation.
